variants.cockpit: Rear, raised cockpit of the tandem seat helicopter. The pilot flies mostly through the helmet display and PNVS at night; the cyclic and the two-grip collective (flight grip and mission grip) carry the weapon, sensor and radar controls so the hands stay on the controls.
variants.notes: HOTAS columns are the crewstation sight (HMD / FCR): FCR mode, scan size, scan and LINK work only with FCR sight (manual pp.136-141). The cyclic cage button (8) has no function and is left out; the trigger guard is numbered 11. Mission grip callouts 1-9 are numbered 9-17 after the flight grip 1-8. Panels have no figures in the manual; items follow its numbered lists.
